items.title_en: After 7 months, Glasswing overwelms maintainers with underwhelming findings
items.title_zh: 七个月后，Glasswing 以乏善可陈的结果压垮了维护者
items.summary_en: After seven months of Project Glasswing, VulnCheck attributes 442 CVEs to Anthropic, about 0.5% of all CVEs published this year. Only two of those vulnerabilities have been identified as exploited in the wild. Of Anthropic's 37,966 reported findings, 7,349, or 19.4%, have been made public, and only 217 have been marked fixed.
items.summary_zh: Project Glasswing 运行七个月后，VulnCheck 将 442 个 CVE 归因于 Anthropic，约占今年发布的全部 CVE 的 0.5%。其中只有两个漏洞被确认已在现实环境中遭到利用。Anthropic 报告的 37,966 个发现中，仅 7,349 个（19.4%）已公开，标记为已修复的只有 217 个。

items.title_en: .name Grandfathered
items.title_zh: .name 域名获得保留
items.summary_en: Verisign has withdrawn its plan to terminate 22,000 .name domain names and email redirects after a prolonged campaign. New registrations for third-level .name domains will close, but all existing domains and redirects will remain indefinitely. The reversal followed efforts by domain owners, lawyers, and supporters to challenge the plan through ICANN.
items.summary_zh: 经过一场旷日持久的抗争，Verisign 撤回了终止 22,000 个 .name 域名及其邮件转发的计划。虽然 .name 三级域名将停止新注册，但现有域名和邮件转发服务将无限期保留。这一转变源于域名所有者、律师和支持者通过 ICANN 发起的共同争取。

items.title_en: Smart home devices should work without the internet
items.title_zh: 智能家居应当无需互联网也能运行
items.summary_en: The author describes a decade-long home-automation rule: no core function in the house should depend on a vendor’s server. As a result, the home continues operating when the internet goes down. The post presents the other automation rules and two related talks that grew out of this principle.
items.summary_zh: 作者介绍了坚持十年的家庭自动化原则：家中的核心功能不应依赖厂商服务器。因此，即使互联网中断，房屋仍能继续运行。文章还整理了由这一原则延伸出的其他自动化规则和两场相关演讲。

items.title_en: Scion is back and is going to sell a kei truck in America
items.title_zh: Scion 回归，将在美国销售一款 Kei 微型卡车
items.summary_en: Toyota has officially revived the Scion marque, which was retired in 2016 after years of financial struggles. The new “Scion by Toyota” is being positioned as a “freedom lab” focused on challenging conventional automotive thinking, and its initial offerings include a kei truck, a bike, and a hybrid side-by-side. The brand’s new direction is a sharp departure from its former role as a quirky, budget-oriented line aimed largely at younger buyers.
items.summary_zh: 丰田正式复活了 Scion 品牌；该品牌曾因长期经营困难于 2016 年停运。全新的“Scion by Toyota”被定位为一个挑战传统汽车思维的“自由实验室”，首批产品包括一款 Kei 微型卡车、一辆自行车和一款混合动力并排式越野车。品牌的新方向与过去面向年轻消费者、主打古怪且价格亲民车型的定位大相径庭。

items.title_en: Blender 5.3 released with Gaussian Splat support
items.title_zh: Blender 5.3 发布，支持 Gaussian Splat
items.summary_en: Blender 5.3 adds native support for 3D Gaussian Splats. Users can import splats as point clouds, experiment with Geometry Nodes, preview them in Workbench, and render them with EEVEE or Cycles. The release also includes DLSS denoising, light dispersion, an EEVEE fisheye effect, Outliner sorting, and ripple video editing.
items.summary_zh: Blender 5.3 新增了对 3D Gaussian Splat 的原生支持。用户可以将其作为点云导入，使用 Geometry Nodes 进行实验，在 Workbench 中预览，并通过 EEVEE 或 Cycles 渲染。该版本还加入 DLSS 降噪、光色散、EEVEE 鱼眼效果、大纲视图排序和波纹视频编辑等功能。

items.title_en: A great old-timey game-programming hack (2013)
items.title_zh: 一个绝妙的老派游戏编程技巧（2013）
items.summary_en: The author recalls programming computer games as a college undergraduate during the 8-bit PC era. Because the hardware was extremely slow by modern standards, game programmers used unconventional techniques to make games run at playable speeds. The piece looks back at one such old-school programming hack.
items.summary_zh: 作者回忆了自己在大学本科时期、8 位 PC 时代编写电脑游戏的经历。由于当时的硬件按现代标准看极其缓慢，游戏程序员会使用各种非常规技巧，让游戏达到可玩的速度。文章回顾了这样一种老派编程诀窍。

items.title_en: Synaptics patent claims stop work on DisplayLink drivers
items.title_zh: Synaptics 的专利主张叫停 DisplayLink 驱动开发
items.summary_en: Mike Lothian tried to improve a Linux driver for a DisplayLink docking station after finding its performance inadequate. Synaptics, which acquired DisplayLink in 2022, responded with patent-infringement claims, a demand to stop the unauthorized implementation, and warnings of costly legal penalties. Linux users of the company’s docks therefore appear likely to remain without feature parity for now.
items.summary_zh: Mike Lothian 认为 DisplayLink 扩展坞在 Linux 下性能不佳，因此尝试改进其驱动。DisplayLink 于 2022 年被 Synaptics 收购，而 Synaptics 随后以专利侵权为由要求停止未经授权的实现，并警告可能面临高昂法律处罚。因此，相关扩展坞的 Linux 用户目前似乎仍将无法获得与其他平台相当的功能。

items.title_en: Starlink Mini 2
items.title_zh: Starlink Mini 2
items.summary_en: Starlink Mini 2 is presented as providing fast, reliable internet both at home and on the go. The service is intended to support streaming, video calls, gaming, and other high-speed connectivity needs, including in rural and remote locations.
items.summary_zh: Starlink Mini 2 被定位为可在家中和移动途中提供快速、可靠的互联网连接。该服务支持流媒体、视频通话、游戏等高速联网需求，也面向乡村和偏远地区。

items.title_en: Val Town is winding down
items.title_zh: Val Town 即将停止运营
items.summary_en: Val Town has decided to wind down its service. The team thanked users for trusting the platform and apologized that it could no longer continue serving them. The announcement does not provide further details about the shutdown timeline or transition.
items.summary_zh: Val Town 决定逐步停止运营。团队感谢用户对平台的信任，并为无法继续提供服务表示歉意。公告没有进一步说明停运时间表或迁移安排。

items.title_en: Show HN: Get your coding agent off ~2019 JavaScript, onto modern web primitives
items.title_zh: Show HN：让编码代理摆脱约 2019 年的 JavaScript，转向现代 Web 原语
items.summary_en: A Chrome-led project provides coding agents with curated guidance on modern, native web APIs. Examples include CSS highlights, dialog and showModal(), and field-sizing, which can replace common JavaScript-heavy patterns. The open-source release contains more than 200 expert-written guides, developed with Firefox, MDN, and Edge, and is designed for agent skills and retrieval-augmented tooling.
items.summary_zh: 一个由 Chrome 发起的项目为编码代理提供现代原生 Web API 的精选指南。例如，CSS Highlights、dialog 与 showModal()、field-sizing 都可以替代常见的重 JavaScript 实现。该开源项目目前包含 200 多份由专家编写的指南，并与 Firefox、MDN 和 Edge 合作开发，面向代理技能和检索增强工具。

items.title_en: AlphaProof Code
items.title_zh: AlphaProof Code
items.summary_en: AlphaProof Code agents generated more than three million lines of machine-checked Lean proof. The proofs verify Signal’s core cryptographic protections down to machine instructions. The result demonstrates the agents’ use in formal verification of security-critical software.
items.summary_zh: AlphaProof Code 代理生成了超过 300 万行经过机器检查的 Lean 证明。这些证明将 Signal 的核心加密防护验证到了机器指令级别。该成果展示了这类代理在安全关键软件形式化验证中的用途。

items.title_en: Six Math Essentials by Terence Tao
items.title_zh: Terence Tao 的六个数学要点
items.summary_en: In Six Math Essentials, Fields Medalist Terence Tao introduces six concepts that span mathematical thinking from antiquity to the modern frontier. The book covers numbers, algebra, geometry, probability, analysis, and dynamics as gateways to quantitative thought, abstraction, calculation, uncertainty, scale, and change. No errata have been recorded for the book.
items.summary_zh: 菲尔兹奖得主 Terence Tao 在《六个数学要点》中介绍了贯穿古代至现代数学前沿的六个核心概念。全书分别以数字、代数、几何、概率、分析和动力学为入口，讨论定量思维、抽象、计算、不确定性、尺度与变化。目前该书尚无勘误记录。

items.title_en: Apple has new Mac app coming to make running local AI models easy
items.title_zh: Apple 将推出让本地运行 AI 模型更简单的 Mac 应用
items.summary_en: Apple is reportedly developing a Mac app called Harbor to simplify running local AI models across one or more Macs. Evidence of the app was found by leaker Aaron Perris. The project comes as Macs are increasingly being used to run models locally, including on the Mac Studio and Mac mini.
items.summary_zh: 据报道，Apple 正在开发一款名为 Harbor 的 Mac 应用，用于简化在一台或多台 Mac 上运行本地 AI 模型的过程。泄密者 Aaron Perris 发现了这款应用的相关证据。随着 Mac Studio、Mac mini 等设备被越来越多地用于本地运行模型，该项目正处于这一趋势之中。

items.title_en: The Apple Support Community will permanently close on November 20, 2026
items.title_zh: Apple 支持社区将于 2026 年 11 月 20 日永久关闭
items.summary_en: Apple Support Community is scheduled to close permanently on November 20, 2026. The community currently lets users search for answers and ask questions about Apple products.
items.summary_zh: Apple 支持社区计划于 2026 年 11 月 20 日永久关闭。该社区目前允许用户搜索答案并就 Apple 产品提问。

items.title_en: Amazon saves millions by replacing Sonnet 4.6 with Strands Decider
items.title_zh: 亚马逊用 Strands Decider 替代 Sonnet 4.6，节省数百万美元
items.summary_en: Two Amazon engineers replaced Claude Sonnet 4.6 with Strands Decider in a major internal ticketing system. Sonnet had provided a balance of intelligence and cost, but Strands Decider reportedly performed equally well at 98% lower cost. The change is expected to save millions of dollars in annual token expenses.
items.summary_zh: 亚马逊的两名工程师在一个大型内部工单系统中，用 Strands Decider 替代了 Claude Sonnet 4.6。Sonnet 原本在智能程度和成本之间取得了平衡，但据称 Strands Decider 在表现相当的情况下将成本降低了 98%。这一调整预计每年可节省数百万美元的 token 费用。

items.title_en: AI usage generates a fragile codebase
items.title_zh: AI 使用会产生脆弱的代码库
items.summary_en: The author says that at Meta, they generated at least 90% of their code with AI during their final months, yet did not see output multiply. They observed AI-assisted code that was brittle, created subtle technical debt, and sometimes contained obvious issues missed during review. One example used JavaScript mouseover events instead of the scalable CSS :hover selector.
items.summary_zh: 作者表示，在 Meta 任职的最后几个月里，自己至少有 90% 的代码由 AI 生成，但产出并没有因此成倍增加。作者观察到一些高度依赖 AI 的代码较为脆弱，会造成隐性的技术债务，有时连明显问题也未被优秀程序员发现。其中一个例子用 JavaScript 鼠标悬停事件实现 CSS 效果，而不是使用更具扩展性的 :hover 选择器。

items.title_en: AMD's Zen 6 Family: Feeding the Beast
items.title_zh: AMD Zen 6 家族：喂饱这头巨兽
items.summary_en: The source excerpt provides only an opening greeting and does not establish technical details about AMD’s Zen 6 family. The piece is presented as an examination of how AMD’s next processor family is supplied with data and compute resources.
items.summary_zh: 现有内容只有开场问候，未提供 AMD Zen 6 家族的具体技术细节。标题表明文章将讨论 AMD 下一代处理器家族如何获得数据和计算资源。

items.title_en: Claude Whiteboards, Claude Sheets, and Claude Data
items.title_zh: Claude Whiteboards、Claude Sheets 和 Claude Data
items.summary_en: Claude is launching Whiteboards and Sheets in beta, while Claude Dashboards becomes generally available as Claude Data. Whiteboards supports shared brainstorming, Sheets lets Claude build and edit spreadsheets, and Claude Data provides data stories, certified queries, and live sharing. All three are available on paid plans and keep documents, boards, sheets, and dashboards inside Claude for team collaboration.
items.summary_zh: Claude 推出了 Whiteboards 和 Sheets 测试版，同时将 Claude Dashboards 正式更名并开放为 Claude Data。Whiteboards 支持协作头脑风暴，Sheets 可由 Claude 创建和编辑电子表格，Claude Data 提供数据故事、认证查询和实时共享。三项功能均面向付费计划，并允许团队在 Claude 内继续协作处理文档、白板、表格和仪表板。

items.title_en: Ableton Live 13
items.title_zh: Ableton Live 13
items.summary_en: Ableton presents Live 13 with experimental sound-design tools, precision mixing effects, and workflow improvements. The new step-sequencer clips support beats, melodies, and polyrhythms. Live 13 also adds support for ARA 2 plug-ins for faster and more advanced audio editing.
items.summary_zh: Ableton 介绍了 Live 13，其中包括实验性声音设计工具、精确混音效果和工作流改进。新的步进音序器片段支持节拍、旋律和复节奏。Live 13 还支持 ARA 2 插件，以实现更快速、更高级的音频编辑。

items.title_en: What objective is reasoning solving?
items.title_zh: 推理究竟在优化什么目标？
items.summary_en: The post questions whether longer chains of thought are themselves what make language models more accurate. During reinforcement learning, models tend to produce longer reasoning chains and improve, but forcing a trained model to continue any one chain eventually stops helping and can even hurt accuracy. This suggests that inference-time reasoning may involve something more subtle than simply increasing chain length.
items.summary_zh: 文章质疑，让思维链变长是否本身就是提高语言模型准确率的原因。在强化学习过程中，模型往往会生成更长的推理链并变得更准确；但对训练完成的模型强行延长某一条思维链，效果最终会停滞，甚至可能降低准确率。这表明，推理时的收益可能并不只是简单增加思维链长度。

items.title_en: Show HN: Valencia, Spain in Sim City/Isometric View
items.title_zh: Show HN：等距视角下的西班牙瓦伦西亚
items.summary_en: This project is an isometric pixel-art map of Valencia, painted block by block. Every building is represented from above at the same angle, covering the municipality from the huerta to the Albufera, with a few small exclusions lacking 3D imagery. The map can be zoomed from the Micalet to the beach.
items.summary_zh: 这是一个逐块绘制的瓦伦西亚等距像素艺术地图。地图以统一的俯视角度呈现每一栋建筑，覆盖从 huerta 到 Albufera 的整个市域，仅少数缺乏 3D 影像的小块 huerta 飞地除外。用户可以从 Micalet 一路缩放查看到海滩。

items.title_en: rVPN – stealth VPN with end-to-end encryption
items.title_zh: rVPN：采用端到端加密的隐蔽 VPN
items.summary_en: rVPN is an open-source stealth VPN protocol that carries traffic in a form indistinguishable from ordinary HTTPS. It is designed to continue working in places where VPNs are blocked. The project makes its code available for reading, auditing, and self-hosting.
items.summary_zh: rVPN 是一种开源隐蔽 VPN 协议，以难以与普通 HTTPS 区分的形式传输流量。它的设计目标是在 VPN 被封锁的地方仍能工作。该项目开放全部代码，供用户阅读、审计和自行运行。

items.title_en: Foldable Flight: The Best Paper Airplanes
items.title_zh: 折叠飞行：最佳纸飞机
items.summary_en: The site presents a large database of paper airplanes with step-by-step video folding tutorials. One World Record prototype is reported to fly more than 300 feet. The Unite model holds a world record for time aloft at 31.2 seconds.
items.summary_zh: 该网站提供大型纸飞机数据库，并为每种机型配备分步折叠视频教程。据称，一款世界纪录原型机可以飞行超过 300 英尺。Unite 机型则以 31.2 秒的滞空时间保持世界纪录。

items.title_en: Sherman Anti-Trust Act (1890)
items.title_zh: 《谢尔曼反托拉斯法》（1890 年）
items.summary_en: The Sherman Anti-Trust Act was approved by the U.S. Congress on July 2, 1890. It was the first federal law to outlaw monopolistic business practices and prohibit trusts. The National Archives preserves the enrolled act and related congressional records.
items.summary_zh: 美国国会于 1890 年 7 月 2 日通过《谢尔曼反托拉斯法》。这是美国第一部禁止垄断性商业行为和托拉斯的联邦法律。美国国家档案馆保存了该法案正本及相关国会记录。

items.title_en: Announcing .NET 11
items.title_zh: 宣布推出 .NET 11
items.summary_en: .NET 11 has been announced as the next release of Microsoft's .NET platform. The supplied excerpt provides no further release details. Its significance depends on the features and changes included in the new version.
items.summary_zh: .NET 11 已宣布成为微软 .NET 平台的下一版本。现有内容未提供更多版本细节。其意义取决于该版本包含的功能和变更。

items.title_en: Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2
items.title_zh: Claude Fable 5.2 与 Mythos 5.2
items.summary_en: Anthropic has introduced Claude Fable 5.2 and Claude Mythos 5.2 for demanding technical tasks. The company says the models improve coding, reasoning, and vision, and that prerelease testing helped engineers complete software migrations, design three working electronic devices, advance robotics evaluations, and formalize a proof of Fermat's Last Theorem. Fable 5.2 is positioned as a new high point for coding, finance, and science.
items.summary_zh: Anthropic 推出了面向高难度技术任务的 Claude Fable 5.2 和 Claude Mythos 5.2。该公司称，这些模型在编程、推理和视觉方面有所提升，并在预发布测试中帮助工程师完成软件迁移、从零设计三种可工作的电子设备、推进机器人评测，以及形式化费马大定理的证明。Fable 5.2 被定位为编程、金融和科学领域的新标杆。

items.title_en: Qwen4-Max is now in Preview
items.title_zh: Qwen4-Max 现已开放预览
items.summary_en: Qwen4-Max is now available in preview through Alibaba's Token Plan. The Qwen4 line is positioned for deeper knowledge, richer world understanding, stronger coding, and agentic capabilities. It is aimed at tasks including complex coding, knowledge work, front-end development, and professional software workflows.
items.summary_zh: Qwen4-Max 现已通过阿里巴巴的 Token Plan 开放预览。Qwen4 系列主打更深入的知识理解、更丰富的世界理解能力，以及更强的编程和智能体能力。其目标任务包括复杂编程、知识工作、前端开发和专业软件流程。

items.title_en: USPS now offers official ZIP Code boundary polygons
items.title_zh: USPS 现提供官方 ZIP Code 边界多边形
items.summary_en: The USPS has released a national ZIP Code boundary map built from delivery-address and location data. The boundaries can change as delivery locations are added or modified, and the data is updated quarterly with limited distribution to subsidiaries and partners. The dataset is intended for mapping, mailing, marketing, insurance, real estate, logistics, navigation, and transportation applications.
items.summary_zh: 美国邮政服务（USPS）发布了基于投递地址和位置数据制作的全国 ZIP Code 边界地图。随着投递地点新增或变更，边界可能发生变化；数据每季度更新一次，并仅向子公司和合作伙伴有限提供。该数据可用于地图、邮寄、营销、保险、房地产、物流、导航和交通等行业。

items.title_en: Tailscale's DNS IPv6 spells out "Tailscale"
items.title_zh: Tailscale 的 DNS IPv6 地址拼出了“Tailscale”
items.summary_en: Tailscale’s DNS IPv6 address is designed so that its hexadecimal representation spells “Tailscale.” This is presented as an Easter egg in the service’s DNS configuration.
items.summary_zh: Tailscale 的 DNS IPv6 地址经过设计，其十六进制表示形式会拼出“Tailscale”。这是该服务 DNS 配置中的一个彩蛋。

items.title_en: $30M Raised to Redo the CPU
items.title_zh: 融资 3000 万美元，重做 CPU
items.summary_en: Tendrils has completed a $30 million funding round led by Benchmark to rebuild general-purpose computing. The company argues that backward compatibility with sequential, single-core processors has left modern CPUs burdened by cache-coherency protocols and reorder buffers. Tendrils says it wants to move general-purpose computing beyond architectures designed for legacy software.
items.summary_zh: Tendrils 已完成由 Benchmark 领投的 3,000 万美元融资，目标是重构通用计算。该公司认为，为兼容顺序式单核处理器，现代 CPU 承担了复杂的缓存一致性协议和重排序缓冲区等历史负担。Tendrils 表示，希望让通用计算超越为旧软件设计的架构。

items.title_en: To deter bioterrorism, U.S. imposes new rules on ordering synthetic DNA
items.title_zh: 为遏制生物恐怖主义，美国对合成 DNA 的订购实施新规
items.summary_en: The United States is imposing new rules on ordering synthetic DNA. The stated purpose is to deter bioterrorism. The available information does not specify the rules' exact requirements or scope.
items.summary_zh: 美国正在对合成 DNA 的订购实施新规则。其目的被表述为遏制生物恐怖主义。现有信息未说明这些规则的具体要求或适用范围。

items.title_en: Google Gemini routes personal Drive files and emails to human annotators
items.title_zh: Google Gemini 将个人 Drive 文件和邮件交由人工标注员处理
items.summary_en: Updated Google guidance reportedly confirms that content from connected Drive and email accounts can enter human-review pipelines for Gemini. This reverses a 2023 promise that personal Gmail, Docs, and Drive content would not be seen by human reviewers. Google now warns users not to connect apps containing confidential information they would not want a reviewer to see.
items.summary_zh: Google 更新后的说明据称确认，连接到 Gemini 的 Drive 和电子邮件账户内容可能进入人工审核流程。这改变了 Google 在 2023 年作出的承诺——当时公司表示个人 Gmail、Docs 和 Drive 内容不会被人工审核员看到。Google 目前警告用户，不要连接包含不希望审核员看到的机密信息的应用。

items.title_en: A comprehensive study of how fingerprintable users are
items.title_zh: 关于用户指纹可识别程度的全面研究
items.summary_en: A large-scale browser-fingerprinting study analyzed telemetry from nearly 25 million Firefox release users. The work examines how identifiable users are through browser characteristics and reports mitigations developed from the findings. The research was conducted by authors from Mozilla, the University of Toronto, and UC San Diego.
items.summary_zh: 一项大规模浏览器指纹研究分析了近 2,500 万名 Firefox 正式版用户的遥测数据。研究考察了通过浏览器特征识别用户的程度，并报告了据此制定的缓解措施。研究人员来自 Mozilla、多伦多大学和加州大学圣迭戈分校。

items.title_en: The Hardest Tarball?
items.title_zh: 最难的 Tar 包？
items.summary_en: The author presents an archive that can be created with a single GNU tar invocation but extracted in eight distinct ways depending on the tool used. The archive contains repeated files, a hard link, an empty file, and a PAX header whose UTF-8 filename and size record alter how the entries are interpreted. Its behavior depends on how extraction tools handle hard-link sizes and the resulting tar-header-sized value.
items.summary_zh: 作者展示了一个只需一次 GNU tar 调用即可构造、却会因解压工具不同而产生八种解压结果的归档文件。该归档包含重复文件、硬链接、空文件，以及一个会改变条目解释方式的 PAX 头，其中记录了 UTF-8 文件名和大小。其行为取决于解压工具如何处理硬链接大小，以及由此产生的恰好等于 tar 头大小的数值。

items.title_en: What constant surveillance is doing to children and parents
items.title_zh: 持续监控正在如何影响儿童和父母
items.summary_en: The source excerpt contains only archived links and does not provide reliable details about the effects of constant surveillance on children or parents. The item concerns location-tracking apps and parental surveillance.
items.summary_zh: 现有内容只有存档链接，未可靠说明持续监控对儿童或父母的具体影响。该条目涉及位置追踪应用和家长监控。

items.title_en: Hooked on Tuna
items.title_zh: 沉迷金枪鱼
items.summary_en: Humans have harvested tuna for 44,000 years, and the fish now support a global industry worth about $40 billion annually. Bluefin tuna, once an inexpensive canned protein, can now sell for millions of dollars at auction. Researchers are studying archaeological remains, rock art, paintings, historical records, and ethnographic accounts to trace this long relationship.
items.summary_zh: 人类捕捞金枪鱼已有 44,000 年历史，如今金枪鱼支撑着年产值约 400 亿美元的全球产业。蓝鳍金枪鱼曾是价格低廉、便于储运的罐头蛋白来源，如今却能在拍卖会上卖出数百万美元。研究人员通过考古遗址中的鱼骨、岩画、绘画、历史记录和民族志资料，追溯人类与金枪鱼的长期关系。

items.title_en: Life on Claude Nine
items.title_zh: Claude 九号上的生活
items.summary_en: The story begins with a man automating his email. At 3 a.m., Ivan is exhausted and has not eaten since lunch while working at a laptop surrounded by a terminal, a Claude chat, and growing Python scripts. He is building the system because he realized he could, not because anyone asked him to.
items.summary_zh: 故事始于一个人自动化处理电子邮件。凌晨 3 点，Ivan 已经筋疲力尽，从午餐后便没有进食，仍守在笔记本前敲代码，屏幕上是终端、Claude 聊天窗口和不断增加的 Python 脚本。他构建这个系统并不是因为有人要求，而是因为意识到自己可以做到。

items.title_en: LLMs Play Zachtronics' TIS-100
items.title_zh: 大语言模型挑战 Zachtronics 的《TIS-100》
items.summary_en: Sixteen LLMs competed on TIS-100's community leaderboard after receiving the game and its manual but not the existing leaderboard. They found 133 new frontier points across 18 of the game's 55 puzzles, including three outright cycle records. Human players subsequently improved most of the models' programs within days.
items.summary_zh: 16 个大语言模型在获得游戏和说明书、但看不到现有排行榜的情况下，挑战了《TIS-100》社区排行榜。它们在 55 道谜题中的 18 道上创造了 133 个新的前沿成绩，其中包括 3 项绝对周期记录。几天之内，人类玩家又改进了这些模型的大多数程序。

items.title_en: An Open Field Guide to Inference Engineering
items.title_zh: 开放式推理工程指南
items.summary_en: This field guide introduces inference concepts, production operations, tooling, and career development for platform engineers. It explains how models and GPUs work together and how to run inference in production. The guide also covers tools and paths for developing an inference-engineering career.
items.summary_zh: 这份实践指南面向平台工程师，介绍推理概念、生产运维、工具和职业发展。内容解释模型与 GPU 如何协同工作，以及如何在生产环境运行推理服务。指南还涵盖相关工具和成长为推理工程师的路径。

items.title_en: Payments Canada announces launch of Canada's Real-Time Rail (RTR) payment system
items.title_zh: Payments Canada 宣布推出加拿大实时铁路支付系统
items.summary_en: Payments Canada announced the launch of Canada’s Real-Time Rail, a national payment system for instant clearing and settlement. Participating financial institutions, credit unions, and payment service providers can exchange, clear, and settle payments securely in real time, 24 hours a day. The system also provides real-time cash-flow visibility and data-rich messaging through existing banking and payment channels.
items.summary_zh: Payments Canada 宣布推出加拿大实时铁路（RTR），这是一个支持即时清算和结算的全国性支付系统。参与其中的金融机构、信用合作社和支付服务商可以全年全天候安全地实时交换、清算和结算付款。该系统还通过现有银行和支付渠道提供实时现金流可见性以及包含丰富数据的消息传递。

items.title_en: E-means: Outperforming k-means in one-tenth the epochs
items.title_zh: E-means：用十分之一的训练轮次超越 k-means
items.summary_en: E-means is presented as an alternative to Lloyd's k-means algorithm. Across a broad range of scales and datasets, it reached lower test loss than Lloyd's method in 1.2 to 3 epochs, compared with 25 epochs. The reported end-to-end speedup is 10–45× over Flash-KMeans on GPUs and 8–15× over Faiss on CPUs.
items.summary_zh: E-means 被介绍为 Lloyd k-means 算法的一种替代方案。在多种规模和数据集上，E-means 用 1.2 至 3 个训练轮次就达到了低于 Lloyd 方法的测试损失，而后者需要 25 个轮次。报告称，端到端速度相比 GPU 上的 Flash-KMeans 提升 10–45 倍，相比 CPU 上的 Faiss 提升 8–15 倍。

items.title_en: Your TV can see through walls (2025)
items.title_zh: 你的电视可以看穿墙壁（2025）
items.summary_en: The project examines whether television signals can be used to observe activity through walls. The available excerpt shows a spectrogram of a local ATSC digital television signal recorded with an Ettus USRP B200. It does not provide further details about the sensing method or results.
items.summary_zh: 该项目研究电视信号是否可以用于观察墙后的活动。现有内容展示了使用 Ettus USRP B200 录制的本地 ATSC 数字电视信号频谱图。内容没有进一步说明感知方法或实验结果。

items.title_en: Queens Public Library under ransomware attack
items.title_zh: 皇后区公共图书馆遭遇勒索软件攻击
items.summary_en: Queens Public Library reported a significant network outage affecting all of its locations. The libraries were closed on November 11 for Veterans Day and were otherwise announced as open as scheduled despite the outage. The available notice does not confirm the cause of the network disruption.
items.summary_zh: 皇后区公共图书馆报告称，所有馆点均受到严重网络中断影响。图书馆 11 月 11 日因退伍军人节闭馆，除该节日外仍宣布按计划开放，尽管网络故障持续存在。现有公告没有确认网络中断的原因。

items.title_en: AI is an information gateway. Audiences still don't want it making their news
items.title_zh: AI 正成为信息入口，但受众仍不希望它替自己生产新闻
items.summary_en: Across nine countries, an average of 24% of respondents said they had seen a label indicating that content was made with AI during the previous week. An average of 20% had seen a bullet-point AI summary of news. These figures describe the visibility of AI-generated labels and summaries among audiences in the surveyed countries.
items.summary_zh: 在九个国家中，平均 24% 的受访者表示自己在上一周见过标明内容由 AI 制作的标签。平均 20% 的受访者见过以要点形式呈现的 AI 新闻摘要。这些数据反映了受访国家受众接触 AI 生成标签和摘要的情况。

items.title_en: Show HN: Every satellite that passed over any place this week, and its photos
items.title_zh: Show HN：查看本周经过任意地点的每颗卫星及其照片
items.summary_en: Watched lets users enter a location and find every satellite that passed over it in the previous seven days, then retrieve Sentinel-2, Landsat, and NASA imagery from those passes. Its browser-based SGP4 search processes the CelesTrak catalog in about half a second, while roughly 17,000 orbital objects are rendered on the GPU. The project reports no missed passes in tests against brute-force searches and says it does not store locations.
items.summary_zh: Watched 允许用户输入地点，查找过去七天内经过该地点的所有卫星，并获取这些过境对应的 Sentinel-2、Landsat 和 NASA 影像。它在浏览器中使用 SGP4 处理 CelesTrak 目录，耗时约半秒，同时在 GPU 上绘制约 1.7 万个轨道目标。项目称，与暴力搜索对比测试未漏掉任何过境，并表示不会存储用户位置。

items.title_en: Fossil CO2 emissions decrease in 2026
items.title_zh: 2026 年化石燃料二氧化碳排放下降
items.summary_en: The 2026 Global Carbon Budget projects that fossil-fuel carbon dioxide emissions will fall by 0.4% this year. The projected decline is attributed to the expansion of solar and wind power and the Iran conflict. Total fossil CO2 emissions are projected at 38.2 billion tonnes.
items.summary_zh: 《2026 年全球碳预算》预计，今年化石燃料二氧化碳排放量将下降 0.4%。预计降幅源于太阳能和风能扩张以及伊朗冲突。化石燃料二氧化碳排放总量预计为 382 亿吨。

items.title_en: Fireworks AI security breach impacts Notion and their customers
items.title_zh: Fireworks AI 安全漏洞影响 Notion 及其客户
items.summary_en: Notion says a security incident at its vendor Fireworks AI may have affected fewer than 1% of Notion workspaces. Some unattributable chat sessions with Notion AI may have been exposed, but the transcripts contained no tool-call results and could not be tied to a user, workspace, or company. Notion says no other workspace data was affected.
items.summary_zh: Notion 表示，其供应商 Fireworks AI 的一次安全事件可能影响了不到 1% 的 Notion 工作区。部分与 Notion AI 的聊天会话可能被暴露，但这些记录没有标注用户或工作区，也不包含工具调用结果，无法追溯到具体用户、工作区或公司。Notion 表示，工作区中的其他数据未受影响。

items.title_en: The death knell of digital search
items.title_zh: 数字搜索的丧钟
items.summary_en: The piece argues that search is increasingly being replaced or reshaped by AI answers from systems such as Gemini, Claude, and ChatGPT. Examples include Gmail summarizing conversations instead of finding exact addresses, Google Maps guessing destinations, and Google Search placing AI overviews or a full AI mode ahead of traditional links. This shift creates problems for Google’s advertising model, which depends on relevant search results.
items.summary_zh: 文章认为，搜索正越来越多地被 Gemini、Claude 和 ChatGPT 等系统生成的 AI 答案取代或重塑。例子包括 Gmail 总结对话而不是查找确切地址、Google 地图猜测目的地，以及 Google 搜索用 AI 概览或完整 AI 模式取代传统链接。这种转变也给依赖相关搜索结果投放广告的 Google 商业模式带来问题。

items.title_en: Horible public key tricks
items.title_zh: 糟糕的公钥技巧
items.summary_en: The author criticizes the operational complexity of SSL/TLS certificates, including the ACME process and frequent expiration. Maintaining certificates requires automation and continued access to DNS records or a web server. The piece also raises concerns about how certificates are issued and about the security of trusted certificate-authority keys.
items.summary_zh: 作者批评 SSL/TLS 证书在运维上的复杂性，包括 ACME 流程和频繁过期问题。证书维护需要自动化，并持续确保 ACME 客户端能够访问 DNS 记录或 Web 服务器。文章还质疑证书的签发方式，以及受信任证书颁发机构密钥的安全性。

items.title_en: M John Harrison becomes first science fiction author to win the Booker
items.title_zh: M·约翰·哈里森成为首位获得布克奖的科幻作家
items.summary_en: Eighty-one-year-old M. John Harrison has won the Booker Prize for The End of Everything, a post-apocalyptic novel set on a near-future Kent coast. He becomes the oldest winner in the prize’s history. The award is worth £50,000.
items.summary_zh: 81 岁的 M·约翰·哈里森凭借《一切的终结》获得布克奖。这部后末日小说以近未来的肯特海岸为背景，使他成为该奖历史上最年长的获奖者。奖金额为 50,000 英镑。

items.title_en: Muse Ember: Our smallest, most efficient model
items.title_zh: Muse Ember：我们最小、最高效的模型
items.summary_en: Meta introduced Muse Ember as its smallest and most efficient model for complex reasoning execution and repetitive agent work. The target workloads include tool calls, coding subtasks, routing, extraction, and long-document parsing. Meta says it matches Claude Haiku 5.5's best score at about one-third the cost and beats every listed GPT-6 Luna setting.
items.summary_zh: Meta 发布了 Muse Ember，称其为用于复杂推理执行和重复性智能体工作的最小、最高效模型。目标工作负载包括工具调用、编程子任务、路由、信息抽取和长文档解析。Meta 称，该模型以约三分之一的成本达到 Claude Haiku 5.5 的最佳成绩，并超过所列出的 GPT-6 Luna 各项设置。

items.title_en: SEC Enforcement Failures Abandon Investors, Benefit Crooks
items.title_zh: SEC 执法失误抛弃投资者、纵容犯罪分子
items.summary_en: Better Markets criticized the SEC after it released enforcement results for the fiscal year ending September 30, 2026. Its securities policy director, Benjamin Schiffrin, said the agency's enforcement activity had declined during Chair Paul Atkins's tenure and argued that the statistics showed it had abandoned its investor-protection duty. These claims are presented as a statement from Better Markets rather than as independent findings in the excerpt.
items.summary_zh: Better Markets 在 SEC 发布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日财年的执法结果后对其提出批评。该组织证券政策主任 Benjamin Schiffrin 称，SEC 在主席 Paul Atkins 任期内的执法活动有所下降，并认为相关统计数据表明 SEC 放弃了保护投资者的职责。现有摘录中的这些说法来自 Better Markets 的声明，而非独立调查结论。

items.title_en: iCloud Down
items.title_zh: iCloud 服务中断
items.summary_en: The item concerns the status of iCloud and other Apple services. The available status page description covers planned and unplanned service events but does not specify the cause, scope, or duration of an outage.
items.summary_zh: 该条目涉及 iCloud 和其他 Apple 服务的状态。现有状态页说明涵盖计划内和非计划服务事件，但未说明此次中断的原因、范围或持续时间。

items.title_en: Let over Lambda–50 Years of Lisp (2008)
items.title_zh: 《Let over Lambda》：Lisp 五十年（2008）
items.summary_en: Let Over Lambda is a 376-page programming book focused on Common Lisp and advanced macro techniques. It begins with fundamentals before covering macros and other advanced language features. The book presents macros as programs that write programs, enabling abstraction, productivity, code efficiency, and security.
items.summary_zh: 《Let Over Lambda》是一本 376 页、专注于 Common Lisp 和高级宏技术的编程书。全书从基础开始，逐步介绍宏及其他高级语言特性。书中将宏描述为“编写程序的程序”，强调其在抽象、生产力、代码效率和安全性方面的作用。

items.title_en: Work at the Frontier: AI's effect on freelance work
items.title_zh: 前沿工作：AI 对自由职业的影响
items.summary_en: Research from OpenAI and Upwork finds changing demand for freelance services, new combinations of skills, and larger budgets and more hours for AI-related projects. Some familiar services are losing market share as clients request different capabilities. AI projects are instead combining multiple skills and tending to involve larger scopes.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 与 Upwork 的研究发现，自由职业服务的需求正在变化，新的技能组合出现，AI 相关项目的预算和工时也更高。一些熟悉的服务正在失去市场份额，因为客户开始要求不同的能力。相比之下，AI 项目往往需要多种技能协作，规模也更大。

items.title_en: Ultorg: The User Interface for Relational Databases
items.title_zh: Ultorg：关系数据库的用户界面
items.summary_en: Ultorg is a spreadsheet-like interface for querying and editing relational databases across tables and relationships. It is designed to work without SQL or custom CRUD applications. The software is available for macOS, Windows, and Linux with a 14-day free trial.
items.summary_zh: Ultorg 是一个类似电子表格的关系数据库界面，可跨表和关系查询、编辑数据。它无需 SQL 或定制 CRUD 应用即可使用。该软件支持 macOS、Windows 和 Linux，并提供 14 天免费试用。

items.title_en: Reddit Reviews
items.title_zh: Reddit Reviews
items.summary_en: Reddit has begun testing Reddit Reviews, an experience that organizes product conversations from its communities into dedicated reviews. It highlights important takeaways so shoppers can more easily understand how a product performs in real life. The feature builds on Reddit's product discussions and recommendations as a source of user experience.
items.summary_zh: Reddit 开始测试 Reddit Reviews，将社区中的产品讨论整理成专门的评测内容。该功能会突出重要结论，帮助购物者更容易了解产品在现实使用中的表现。它建立在 Reddit 社区积累的产品讨论和推荐之上。

items.title_en: Businesses in ChatGPT – OpenAI
items.title_zh: ChatGPT 中的企业功能
items.summary_en: OpenAI is introducing Businesses in ChatGPT in beta. Through Business Hub, companies can claim their business listings, keep information current, and see how people engage with them in ChatGPT. Business Agents are also being introduced for eligible U.S. ecommerce and online-service businesses, while the announcement says ChatGPT has 1.2 billion weekly users.
items.summary_zh: OpenAI 推出了 ChatGPT 中的企业功能测试版。企业可以通过 Business Hub 认领商家信息、更新资料，并了解用户在 ChatGPT 中如何与其互动。针对符合条件的美国电商和在线服务企业，平台还开始提供 Business Agents；公告称 ChatGPT 每周拥有 12 亿用户。

items.title_en: Formalizing CPython
items.title_zh: 形式化 CPython
items.summary_en: AI agents wrote 613,318 lines of Lean modeling Python's internals and tested each piece against the real Python implementation. The work uncovered 418 bug reports in Python. A correction excluding GUI-related code changed the modeled coverage from 15.7% to 14.3%.
items.summary_zh: AI 智能体编写了 613,318 行 Lean 代码，用于逐行建模 Python 的内部机制，并将每个部分与真实 Python 实现进行测试。这个过程发现了 Python 中的 418 个 bug 报告。由于修正了对 GUI 相关代码的统计，已建模覆盖率从 15.7% 改为 14.3%。

items.title_en: ClickHouse Acquires Xata
items.title_zh: ClickHouse 收购 Xata
items.summary_en: Xata is joining ClickHouse to bring agentic capabilities to ClickHouse Managed Postgres. The combined effort will target a Postgres platform for modern applications and AI agents. It will combine local-NVMe production workloads with Xata's instant provisioning, copy-on-write branching, and scale-to-zero compute technology.
items.summary_zh: Xata 将加入 ClickHouse，为 ClickHouse Managed Postgres 带来智能体能力。双方将共同打造面向现代应用和 AI 智能体的 Postgres 平台。该平台将把本地 NVMe 存储上的高性能生产负载，与 Xata 的即时数据库配置、写时复制分支和缩容至零计算技术结合起来。

items.title_en: Process Explorer for macOS
items.title_zh: 适用于 macOS 的 Process Explorer
items.summary_en: Microsoft’s Process Explorer for Mac is a native macOS implementation of the core Process Explorer experience. It provides a live process tree, module, handle, and thread inspection, per-process properties, system-wide performance graphs, and code-signing checks. The Swift, SwiftUI, and AppKit application uses public macOS APIs, with optional support for a privileged helper.
items.summary_zh: 微软的 macOS 版 Process Explorer 是对核心 Process Explorer 体验的原生实现。它提供实时进程树、模块、句柄和线程检查、逐进程属性、系统级性能图表以及代码签名检查。该应用使用 Swift、SwiftUI 和 AppKit 构建，并通过 macOS 公共 API 工作，还可选择使用特权辅助程序。

items.title_en: Go Turns 17
items.title_zh: Go 迎来 17 周年
items.summary_en: Go celebrated the 17th anniversary of its open-source release on November 10, 2026. The anniversary was marked by the Go team. The milestone records 17 years since the language became open source.
items.summary_zh: Go 于 2026 年 11 月 10 日迎来开源发布 17 周年。Go 团队对这一纪念日进行了庆祝。这一里程碑标志着该语言开源至今已有 17 年。

items.title_en: Movistar Blocks Its Own Support Forum Under LaLiga Anti-Piracy Order
items.title_zh: 西班牙反盗版禁令下，Movistar 屏蔽了自己的支持论坛
items.summary_en: Spain's court-ordered piracy-blocking system blocked Movistar's official customer-support forum on a Saturday night. Internet providers must block hundreds of IP addresses linked to pirate football streams during every LaLiga match weekend. The regime comes from a December 2024 court order obtained by LaLiga and Telefónica Audiovisual Digital, and applies even to Telefónica's own network.
items.summary_zh: 西班牙法院下令实施的盗版屏蔽机制在一个周六晚间屏蔽了 Movistar 的官方客户支持论坛。每逢西甲比赛周末，互联网服务商都必须屏蔽数百个与盗播足球相关的 IP 地址。该机制源自 LaLiga 和 Telefónica Audiovisual Digital 于 2024 年 12 月取得的法院命令，甚至适用于 Telefónica 自己的网络。

items.title_en: The Surprising Effectiveness of Deleting Weights in LLM Post-Training
items.title_zh: 在 LLM 后训练中删除权重的惊人效果
items.summary_en: The researchers found that zeroing fewer than 0.05% of a pretrained LLM's weights can match full fine-tuning across reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards, supervised fine-tuning, and on-policy distillation. Their Deletion Tuning method learns a binary mask over transformer gate projections, producing a checkpoint hundreds to thousands of times smaller than a full fine-tuning checkpoint. It also preserves prior-task accuracy better than full fine-tuning, LoRA, and random sparse fine-tuning in the reported reinforcement-learning experiments.

Names are disambiguated using region, elevation, and OpenStreetMap IDs, while a committed registry prevents a slug from being reassigned. The dataset contains 42,866 places: 9,429 huts and bivouacs plus 33,437 named peaks.
items.summary_zh: 该项目为 biwak.info 上的阿尔卑斯山小屋、露营地和山峰提供简短、易读且始终指向同一地点的 URL。名称冲突时会依次加入地区、海拔和 OpenStreetMap ID 进行区分，并通过已提交的注册表防止 slug 被重新分配。数据集共包含 42,866 个地点，其中有 9,429 座小屋和露营地，以及 33,437 座有名称的山峰。

items.title_en: Twelve things you could build on a live index of internet radio
items.title_zh: 基于实时互联网广播索引可以构建的十二件事
items.summary_en: Tuneping tracks what about 23,000 radio stations are playing now and what 58,000 stations played over recent weeks. The post proposes twelve projects that could use this live index, including email notifications triggered by releases. It also describes the endpoints and implementation plans, with most ideas intended to fit into a weekend.
items.summary_zh: Tuneping 记录约 23,000 个电台当前播放的内容，以及约 58,000 个电台过去几周播放过的内容。文章提出了 12 个可以利用这一实时索引的项目，包括在新作品发布当天发送邮件通知。文中还说明了所需接口和实现计划，其中大多数想法预计一个周末即可完成。

items.title_en: Lighting the Skies
items.title_zh: 照亮天空
items.summary_en: The piece considers the role of technology in warfare, beginning with early expectations that a mechanical device would decide World War I. It places nuclear weapons in a broader historical context, noting that they became available only very late in World War II and that the conventional firebombing of Tokyo may have caused as many deaths as the attacks on Hiroshima and Nagasaki. The discussion questions whether nuclear weapons had the decisive impact on the war that is often assumed.
items.summary_zh: 文章从一战早期人们认为某种机械装置将决定战争胜负的期待出发，讨论技术在战争中的作用。文章将核武器置于更广泛的历史背景中，指出核武器直到二战末期才出现，而东京的常规燃烧弹轰炸可能造成了与广岛、长崎核攻击相当的死亡人数。文章因此质疑核武器是否真的像通常认为的那样，对战争产生了决定性影响。

items.title_en: What It Costs to Run 4 Apps on My Own Servers
items.title_zh: 在自己的服务器上运行 4 个应用的成本
items.summary_en: The author runs four production applications, each with its own PostgreSQL database, workers, scheduled jobs, and backups, for about $45 per month. Hydrafetch, DataHyena, CatchIntent, and Eternal Vault all run on a single self-managed server. The post breaks down the bill, the gaps in that budget, and the problems encountered along the way.
items.summary_zh: 作者在一台自行搭建的服务器上运行四个生产应用，每个应用都有自己的 PostgreSQL 数据库、后台工作进程、定时任务和备份，总成本约为每月 45 美元。这四个产品是 Hydrafetch、DataHyena、CatchIntent 和 Eternal Vault。文章详细拆解了费用、这笔预算无法覆盖的部分，以及过程中遇到的问题。
